question: Kostka cukru, kterou házíme do kávy, je český vynález. Vznikla poté, co se manželka ředitele cukrovaru řízla při sekání cukrové homole. Ve kterém jihočeském městě se to stalo?
source_excerpt: In 1842 he patented the cubes, and they made Dačice famous around the world.

extra.why_interesting: People take the sugar cube for granted as a faceless industrial product. In fact it was born in a small South Bohemian town out of a husband's care for his injured wife, and Czechs love discovering a world-famous invention at home.
extra.verification_notes: Sugar cube was invented in Dačice by refinery director Jakub Kryštof Rad after his wife Juliana injured herself cutting a sugar loaf; sources agree on the town (https://forbes.cz/kostky-jsou-vrzeny-ty-cukrove-jsou-vynalezem-z-dacic-a-prave-maji-vyroci/).

explanation: Ředitel dačického cukrovaru Jakub Kryštof Rad pak své ženě daroval krabičku úhledných kostek a vynález si nechal patentovat. Dnes tam kostce cukru stojí i vlastní pomník.

question: Na palivoměru v autě je vedle ikonky benzínové pumpy malá šipka nebo trojúhelníček. Co vám ta šipka prozrazuje?
alternative_answers: Na kterou stranu zajet k pumpě
source_excerpt: A left-pointing arrow means the gas cap is on the driver's side, and a right-pointing arrow means the passenger side.

extra.why_interesting: Players on a car trip see this icon all the time and assume the little triangle is decoration or just a fuel warning. In fact it answers the classic petrol-station question 'which side is my tank on?', which is very useful in a rental or borrowed car. The player can reason it out from the setting, and the answer gives an instant 'I never noticed that!' moment they can check on the dashboard right away.
extra.verification_notes: The arrow beside the fuel pump icon indicates the side of the car with the fuel filler cap/tank, per https://www.motor1.com/news/804101/what-fuel-gauge-arrow-means/

explanation: Šipka ukazuje, na které straně auta je víčko nádrže, takže v půjčeném autě víte, ke kterému stojanu zajet. Klidně se teď podívejte na palubní desku.
